title: Elemental
tagline: Fire meets water. Dinner meets you.
about: A fiery young woman and a soft-hearted water guy fall for each other in Element City.
cue: Serve the snacks when Ember works the counter at her family's shop.
faces: FIRE MEETS WATER. DINNER MEETS YOU.
The blue flame the family carried over
Open 4 pm to midnight, not Mondays.
Lumen family shop. One blue flame, always lit.
Cashews and peanuts roasted with honey, chilli and smoked paprika.
Cucumber rounds topped with whipped feta and yoghurt.
Yoghurt dough brushed with chilli oil, grilled charred at the edges, with thick strained yoghurt.
Charcoal grilled halloumi with chilli honey
Too hot for Wade. He'll cry anyway.
Lamb shoulder braised with harissa, cumin, tomato and chickpeas.
Meringue topped with whipped cream, blueberries and edible purple flowers.
Apple juice warmed with cinnamon, cloves, orange peel and ginger.
Ember's flame keeps it hot to the last sip.
One of every course, packed in one bag, ready by the opening credits.

    StartersFireplace shop hot nutsCashews and peanuts roasted with honey, chilli and smoked paprikaHow to make it200g cashews200g peanuts2 tbsp honey1/2 tsp chilli flakes1/2 tsp smoked paprikaToss the cashews and peanuts with the honey, chilli flakes and paprika.Spread on a lined tray.Roast at 170°C until glossy.Cool until crunchy.Feta cucumber roundsCucumber rounds topped with whipped feta and yoghurtHow to make it2 Lebanese cucumbers150g feta150g Greek yoghurt1/2 lemon2 tbsp dill, choppedcracked pepper, to tasteSlice the cucumbers into thick rounds.Whip the feta, yoghurt and a squeeze of lemon until smooth.Pipe or spoon onto each round.Finish with dill and cracked pepper.Firetown harissa flatbreads with labnehYoghurt dough brushed with chilli oil, grilled charred at the edges, with thick strained yoghurtHow to make itNot on tonight's cookFlatbreads brushed with harissa stirred into olive oil, grilled until charred at the edges, torn and served with thick labneh.Mix 300g self-raising flour with 300g Greek yoghurt and a pinch of salt into a soft dough and knead 1 minute.Divide into 4 and roll each into a thin oval.Stir 2 tbsp harissa into 3 tbsp olive oil.Cook the flatbreads on a very hot dry pan or grill for 2 minutes a side until puffed and charred at the edges, brushing with the harissa oil as they come off.Spread 250g labneh on a plate, drizzle with oil and za'atar and serve with the torn flatbreads.Charcoal grilled halloumi with chilli honeyToo hot for Wade. He'll cry anyway.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsBernie's fiery lambLamb shoulder braised with harissa, cumin, tomato and chickpeasHow to make it1kg lamb shoulder, diced2 tbsp olive oil2 tbsp harissa1 tsp ground cumin1 can crushed tomatoes1 can chickpeas, drained250ml water4 flatbreadsDice the lamb and brown it in the oil in batches.Stir in the harissa and cumin.Add the tomatoes, chickpeas and water.Cover and braise at 160°C until it pulls apart.Warm the flatbread and serve alongside.SweetsVivisteria pavlovaMeringue topped with whipped cream, blueberries and edible purple flowersHow to make it4 eggs, whites only220g caster sugar300ml thickened cream250g blueberries1 punnet edible purple flowersWhisk the egg whites to stiff peaks.Add the sugar a spoon at a time until glossy.Shape into a round and bake at 120°C.Cool in the oven with the door closed.Whip the cream, top the pavlova with cream, blueberries and purple flowers.DrinksFiretown hot spiced appleApple juice warmed with cinnamon, cloves, orange peel and gingerHow to make it1 L apple juice6 cinnamon sticks4 cloves1 orange1 piece ginger (3cm), slicedPeel strips of zest from the orange and slice the ginger.Heat the apple juice with 2 cinnamon sticks, the cloves, zest and ginger until steaming.Keep warm so the flavours infuse.Strain into mugs and add a cinnamon stick to each.Smoked chilli hot chocolateEmber's flame keeps it hot to the last sip.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
